name: payload-find-generics-require-collection-name
hook: payload.find<T> first arg must be collection name string, not a data type
body: When calling payload.find<T> in this Payload 3.x codebase, the first generic must be one of the collection name string literals ('transactions', 'users', etc.), NOT a data interface like RecentTransaction. Use `as Promise<{ docs: MyType[] }>` cast instead of a second generic type parameter. This avoids TS2344 errors about constraint satisfaction.
why: TypeScript error TS2344 on line 574 of dashboard-metrics/route.ts showed that the first generic to payload.find must satisfy the constraint of being a valid collection name. All existing calls in this file use `as Promise<...>` casts instead of generics.
